segmente.text: The more you chase money, the harder it becomes to understand how it's made.
Most people who want to become rich spend their time thinking about how much money they want to earn,
instead of understanding what actually makes money valuable.
Because money doesn't appear simply because someone wants it.
It changes hands when people believe they're receiving something worth paying for.
And understanding this completely changes the way you look at the world.
Every successful business exists because it gives customers a reason to spend their money.
Sometimes it's saving time, reducing uncertainty, or solving a problem that would otherwise cost much more.
And the interesting part is that the value of a solution isn't necessarily determined by how difficult it is to create.
It's determined by how valuable the outcome is to the person paying for it.
This is why understanding human behavior can become such a powerful advantage in business.
The better you understand what people want, what frustrates them, and what they're willing to pay for,
the easier it becomes to recognize opportunities.
Because becoming wealthy isn't just about wanting more money.
It's about understanding why money moves,
and building something that gives it a reason to move toward you.
